CREATE VIEW operation.vw_CabSourceSummary
AS

SELECT
    'stage.NYCCabTrip_Green' AS SourceTable,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Row_Count
FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Green

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow' AS SourceTable,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Row_Count
FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow;
------------------------------------------------------
CREATE VIEW operation.vw_MigrationObjectCounts
AS

SELECT
    'dw.DimCabType' AS ObjectName,
    'Dimension Table' AS ObjectType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS Row_Count
FROM dw.DimCabType

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.DimLocation',
    'Dimension Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.DimLocation

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.DimPaymentType',
    'Dimension Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.DimPaymentType

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.DimRate',
    'Dimension Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.DimRate

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.DimTripType',
    'Dimension Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.DimTripType

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.DimVendor',
    'Dimension Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.DimVendor

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'dw.FactCabTrip',
    'Fact Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dw.FactCabTrip

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'stage.NYCCabTrip_Green',
    'Stage Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Green

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow',
    'Stage Table',
    COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow;
